dz: 君士坦丁大帝为大幅扩建并重建的拜占庭城举行落成典礼，将其更名为新罗马，并宣布其为东罗马帝国的新首都。
de: Constantine the Great dedicates the much-expanded and rebuilt city of Byzantium, changing its name to New Rome and declaring it the new capital of the Eastern Roman Empire.
